subject: general
question: Sheena steps out from her apartment and walks 9 m towards the south. She takes a right turn and walks 43 m. She takes a right turn again and walks 38 m. Again, she takes a right turn and walks 43 m. She takes a right turn again and walks 12 m. Again, she takes a right turn again and walks 26 m. She then takes a left turn and walks 17 m. She takes a left turn again and walks 12 m to reach point A. How far and in which direction is point A from Sheena's apartment? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given: **All turns are 90 degree turns only

Sheena steps out from her apartment and walks 9 m towards the south.

She takes a right turn and walks 43 m.

She takes a right turn again and walks 38 m.

Again, she takes a right turn and walks 43 m.

She takes a right turn again and walks 12 m.

Again, she takes a right turn again and walks 26 m.

She then takes a left turn and walks 17 m.

She takes a left turn again and walks 12 m to reach point A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/223af80434d9e26c3a711b0a0ec57dc24c8d766ab3028fbef2e7ea09f1a46fc8.png] 

So, the distance between point A and Sheena's apartment is: (26 - 12) = 14 m

Thus, point A is 14 m away from Sheena's apartment in the west direction.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
